intent: Apply the user-approved Package A in order: classify optional enrichment availability versus defects; make the capability index a deterministic generated artifact; make current-research overlay mode explicit across entrypoints; and split membership model judgment runs from durable semantic decisions with bounded deterministic deep-reasoning triggers. Preserve existing Evidence/Reality/Judgment/Outcome/no-lookahead truth semantics.
rationale_summary: Remove engineering ambiguity before expanding research semantics. Optional enrichment must distinguish expected provider unavailability, empty successful results and implementation defects. Capability cards remain the canonical governance source while active-index is generated and CI-checks drift without rewriting it. Current overlay mode must be explicit at application boundaries. Membership model executions become append-only provenance separate from the durable semantic decision; deep reasoning gains narrow deterministic triggers plus model self-escalation. No truth-authority boundary is relaxed.
